facts.text: parseArgs defaults to agents 4, chains 50, facts 100 and probes 20, with seed 1 and no json path.
The --agents option requires an integer of at least 3, so a fleet run always has three or more writer processes.
fail writes fleet-eval: plus the message to stderr, runs the cleanup hook, then exits with code 2.
When the Release build is absent and DOSSIER_BIN is unset, the script fails with a message to build Release or set DOSSIER_BIN.
A .dll spec labels the binary through path.relative(repoRoot, file) and runs it as an argument to dotnet.
prng is a deterministic mulberry32 generator, so one seed reproduces the same plan.
at: Deterministic PRNG (mulberry32), so a seed reproduces the plan

facts.text: Each Agent spawns the binary with mcp as its subcommand and DOSSIER_DB set to the shared database path.
rpc rejects a call that gets no answer within 60_000 ms, reporting the agent name and method as timed out.
initialize sends protocolVersion 2025-06-18 and sets clientInfo name to the agent label, which becomes the provenance actor.
wilson returns a 95% Wilson score interval using a z value of 1.959964.
A rate row with an expected value of null is marked ok and is never pushed into failures.
Each provenance chain posts four facts keyed observation, hypothesis, mitigation and verification, one per step.
Each chain step is posted by writer(index + step), so consecutive steps come from different agents.
In the sequential contradiction case the second writer adds a contradicts ref with basis observed pointing at the first fact.
A contradictory pair counts as admitted only when both posts return status new and the two ids differ.
Supersession claims use the key timeoutSeconds with values 10 plus index mod 50 and 100 plus index mod 50.
A supersession slot counts only when live.length is 1 and superseded.length is 1 among the two posted facts.
The successor check requires the superseded fact's replaced_by field to equal the live fact's id.
Every fifth chain is a control that reposts the same claim with an extra reviewed tag instead of a changed level.
A descendant's why entry must name derived_from the direct input, with state superseded at the first step and stale after it.
A correction whose supersedes target is missing must fail with code supersedes_target_not_found and store no facts.
Chain completeness walks from the newest fact with cursor && guard < 10, following derived_from refs and reading each through get_fact.
The cli helper runs the dossier CLI on the same database for retract, the one verb MCP does not offer.
at: for the one verb MCP does not offer (retract)

facts.text: cli throws when the spawned dossier command exits with a status other than 0, including its stderr in the message.
The run creates its temporary directory with the prefix dossier-fleet-eval- and removes it during cleanup.
On SIGINT the script runs cleanup and exits with code 130.
inBatches starts at most size jobs at once with Math.min(size, count - start) and awaits each group before the next.
derivedFrom builds a ref with rel derived_from, kind fact, basis derived and the target id.
Each revocation probe posts a marker token built from quartz, the seed, the probe index and zebra.
A retracted fact must return status retracted with no text and a provenance actor for the audit tombstone.
Propagation takes its starting cursor from the next field of a changes call with last 1.
Convergence passes only when the ids collapse to one, fresh is 1 and deduped equals writers.length - 1.
The convergence journal check requires exactly one facts row in the changes page for the subject.
With --json the script writes an object holding options, binary, seconds, revision, rows and failures.
When any expectation fails the script prints each FAILED line to stderr and exits with code 1.
A latency row is recorded with expected null and ok true because it has no pass or fail threshold.
The report closes with a note that scoped access is not measured because every agent on a store reads all of it.
The derivation currency check requires search with status live to return none of the stale descendants.
percentile returns null for an empty sample list and otherwise the nearest-rank element of the sorted copy.
A failed rate adds a failure string naming the experiment, the metric, k over n and the expected value.
Writer agents are named agent- plus their index, and a separate reader agent is created after all of them.
writer maps any index onto the writers array with modulo arithmetic so it always returns a writer.
A conflict counts as surfaced only when its field is region and its values cite both posted facts.
The changed root must verify as superseded with replaced_by equal to the newly posted revision.
After the run the script reads the final revision from a changes call with last 1.
The --help flag prints the usage line and exits with code 0.
parseArgs defaults to agents 4, facts 100, port 8787, keep false and rate 0.
Without a Release build and without DOSSIER_NO_BUILD=1, locateDossier builds Dossier.csproj with dotnet build and -c Release.
If the Release build is still missing, locateDossier falls back to the Debug build after printing a notice.
at: no Release build, using the Debug build

facts.text: pickPort scans up to 50 ports from the requested one and fails when none can be bound.
at: for (let port = start; port < start + attempts; port++)

facts.text: openRevisionStream records a run failure when the answer is not 200 with a text/event-stream content type.
readJournalWindow pages /api/changes with limit 500 for at most 40 pages and stops early on a reset.
McpAgent.call defaults to a 60_000 ms timeout and reports mcp plus the method name when it expires.
die marks the agent dead, counts one error and rejects every in-flight call with a fatal error.
The --kill-agent-after option is a hidden debug hook that kills agent-0's child mid-call.
McpAgent spawns the binary with mcp as the subcommand and sets DOSSIER_DB to the database path.
recordError counts a failed call as busy when its message matches busy or locked, and as other otherwise.
The server child is spawned as serve with --port and DOSSIER_DB set to the same database.
The script probes /api/revision up to 150 times, sleeping 100 ms between attempts, before failing that serve did not answer.
baseRevision is read from /api/revision so the seeder's own writes sit below the stream and journal window.
The graph sampler calls /api/graph with the root subject, depth=1, facts=true and max_nodes=500.
The graph sampler runs every 25 ms and skips a tick while a previous request is still in flight.
Every third fact is posted to live-demo/shared and the others to live-demo/agent- plus the agent index.
Every fact refs the root fact with mentions, and once previous moves off the root it also refs previous with follows.
When --rate is above zero each agent sleeps 1000 / rate milliseconds after every post.
After the writers finish the script takes 10 more graph samples for the after section.
The script sleeps 700 ms before reading the final revision so the server's 500 ms poll can deliver the last write.
The script retries up to 30 times with 100 ms sleeps for the stream's last revision to reach the final revision.
A write error, graph status failure, stream behind, stream failure or journal read error each adds an entry to the failures list.
Fewer distinct actors than requested agents pushes an identity regression failure naming each actor that was seen.
With --keep the script leaves the server running, prints the graph URL and waits forever.
The script exits with code 0 when failures is empty and with code 1 otherwise.
On SIGINT the demo prints live-demo: stopping, runs cleanup and exits with code 0.
httpRequest defaults to a 10_000 ms timeout and destroys the request with a message naming that timeout.
A separate seed agent posts one note under live-demo/root and the script keeps both its fact id and subject id.
usage prints to stdout for code 0 and to stderr otherwise, then exits with that code.
positiveInt fails when the value is not an integer or is below 1, naming the flag in the message.
canBind listens on 127.0.0.1 and resolves false as soon as the probe server raises an error.
readJournalWindow throws when /api/changes answers with a status other than 200.
The reported actor list is the sorted union of the journal actors and the stream actors.
The summary reports journal rows divided by posted facts as rows per posted fact.
